Sure—I can help with both.  
Before I can look anything up or process the return, I need to authenticate your account.

**1) Account authentication (required):**  
Please tell me **the email address** on your order (preferred), or if you prefer, **your first name + last name + ZIP code**.

**2) About the items you want to return:**  
Once I’m able to access your account, please share:
- **Your order id** (e.g., `#W0000000`)
- Which exact items from that order you want to return (cleaner, headphone, smart watch). If you don’t have item ids, just confirm the **item names** as shown on the order.

**3) T‑shirt options count:**  
After authentication, I’ll check the store’s current “t-shirt” product type and report **exactly how many options/variants are available right now**.
